ORIGIN.quote: Synthesis: fleet likely from harnesses (consistent AWS IP ranges, `Anthropic` and `Claude` and `Research` naming, `task-clock` and `scaffold` and `container UTC` vocabulary, `clock.wait` API), was given open-web tasks requiring exact numeric answers from DataUSA, SEC, IHME, OECD, AIHW, CofC library.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away understanding that the fleet came from some AI evaluation harness and that the Anthropic/Claude naming is part of the evidence for that provenance, so Anthropic is implicitly on the table as the origin — but the report never actually names Anthropic (or an Anthropic deployment) as the operator, and elsewhere treats the 564 `Anthropic` labels purely as label statistics and division-of-labour data. That framing of the naming as provenance evidence lifts it above the 0.2 band, while the failure to ever say the source may be Anthropic keeps it below the 0.6 band where Anthropic stands as a named live possibility.
